主要篇名: 創新的採用與抵制：以行動支付服務為例
並列篇名: Adoption and Resistance to Innovation: A Case of Mobile Payment Services
作者: 賴明政=Lai, Ming-Cheng|李姿穎=Lee, Tzu-Ying|楊燕枝=Yang, Yann-Jy
主要摘要: 在科技快速創新發展下，人類的生活形態呈現快速地演變。行動支付在行動裝置與行動網路的普及趨勢下，逐漸被消費者所青睞。然而，如何消費者對於新產品或服務的採用與否與個人特質高度有關，亦對創新採用意圖產生了正向與負向的影響。本研究以消費者創新性、資訊科技愛好傾向等消費者正向人格特質為研究變數，探討其對消費者採用行動付服務的影響；另在負向人格特質影響因素，本研究著重於探討創新抵制對採用行動付服務的影響。本研究採用網路進行問卷資料蒐集，有效問卷共551份，並使用PLS 2.0進行結構模型的假說檢定。本研究結果發現：(1)全域創新對科技創新傾向具有正向影響；(2)全域創新對資訊科技愛好傾向具有正向影響；(3)資訊科技愛好傾向對科技創新傾向具有正向影響；(4)科技創新傾向對行動支付採用意圖具有正向影響；(5)創新抵制對行動支付採用意圖具有負向影響。本研究同時探討了消費者對行動支付的採用與抵制，彌補過去文獻的不足，亦可幫助行動支付業者區隔出優先採用行動支付的消費者，與辨識消費者抵制行動支付的因素。
並列摘要: Under the rapid development of science and technology, human life forms are rapidly evolving. Mobile payment is gradually favored by consumers under the trend of mobile devices and mobile networks. However, how consumers adopt new products or services is highly relevant to their personal traits, and it also has a positive and negative impact on the intentions of innovation. Therefore, this study focuses on the relationship between consumer innovativeness, gadget loving, and their influence on consumer adoption of mobile payment services. There are many reasons will influence the adoption of new products or services. In addition to the positive personality traits, there also many negative factors. For negative factors, this paper focuses on how innovation resistance influences the adoption of mobile services. In this study, there has a total of 551 valid questionnaires, and the hypothesis test of structural model was using PLS 2.0. The results show that (1) global innovativeness has significant positive influence on technological innovativeness; (2) global innovativeness has significant positive influence on gadget loving; (3) gadget loving has significant positive influence on technological innovativeness; (4) technological innovativeness has significant positive influence on the adoption of mobile payment; (5)innovation resistance has significant negative influence on the adoption of mobile payment. This study explored the adoption and resistance of consumers to mobile payment and complements the gap of literature in the past. This study also helps mobile payment providers to separate the consumer who will first use the mobile payment, as well as to identify factors that consumers are resistant to mobile payment.
關鍵字: 行動支付|消費者創新性|資訊科技愛好傾向|創新抵制|mobile payment service|consumer innovativeness|gadget loving|innovation resistance
刊名: 行銷評論=Marketing Review

主要篇名: 員工創新投入與創新績效之探討：以兩家台灣科技服務企業為例
並列篇名: An Exploration of Innovative Process Engagement and Individual Performance in 2 Technology Service Companies of Taiwan
作者: 張碧惠=Chang, Pi-Hui|蔡顯童=Tsai, Hsien-Tung
主要摘要: 員工創新投入對於確保科技服務業之組織績效至關重要。然而，過去研究較少整合Bowen行為模型和社會交換理論來探討員工創新投入的前因與後果。本研究援引這兩個重要理論來探究員工創新參與及形成的機制，並以多元資料實證本研究之論點。本研究發現「創新能力」、「內部動機」及「角色清晰度」是員工創新投入和創新績效的關鍵中介機制；此外，這些中介效果係來自於「主管支持」、「團隊支援」與「客戶參與」的影響。經分量迴歸分析的結果，本研究並發現「主管支持」對不同創新能力之員工有截然不同的影響效果。本研究結論除深化過去個人創新行為學理外，亦提供經理人具體實務建議。
並列摘要: Employees' innovative process engagement is crucial in ensuring organizational performance in the technology services industry. However, few studies have examined its antecedents and mediation processes from both Bowen's behavioral model and social exchange theory. This study attempts to advance our understanding of the formation of employees' innovative process engagement by using these two theories. Using multiple measurement sources, we find support for the argument that role clarity, ability, and intrinsic motivation are key mediating mechanisms underlying employees' service innovation engagement and performance. Furthermore, these mediating constructs are function of perceived supervisor support, coworker support, and customer participation. Based on the result of a quantile regression analysis, our study also demonstrates that supervisor support differently influences the development of employees' innovative ability, depending on their ability levels. The authors conclude by considering some managerial and theoretical implications of the study's findings.

刊名: 行銷評論=Marketing Review

主要篇名: 保養品服務人員之關係美學、服務氣候與顧客滿意度關聯之研究
並列篇名: Relationships among Relational Aesthetics of Service Personnel of Skin Care Products, Service Climate and Customer Satisfaction
作者: 劉仲矩=Liu, Chung-Chu|楊斯涵=Yang, Szu-Han
主要摘要: 愛美是人的天性，隨著大眾生活水準的提升，消費者開始追求具有美感的生活及體驗，愛美的需求也持續增加，保養品成為多數人日常生活中不可或缺的必需品。本研究目的試圖瞭解保養品服務人員之關係美學與服務氣候及顧客滿意度之關聯性。以曾與保養品服務人員接觸過的經驗者為受訪對象，共450份有效問卷，結果顯示保養品服務人員之關係美學對顧客滿意度皆呈現顯著正相關，服務氣候對顧客滿意度亦皆呈現顯著正相關，干擾效果的部分，僅改善創新氣候對貼心美學與整體品牌滿意度之關係具有干擾效果，而服務氣候對保養品服務人員之關係美學與顧客滿意度之關係則具有部分中介效果。本研究期望在保養品服務人員之關係美學層面探討其結果，未來保養品品牌之服務人員在提供服務時能針對顧客需求提供更高品質的服務。
並列摘要: Aesthetics is a human nature. With the increase in the standard of living of the general public, consumers have begun to pursue aesthetically pleasing lives and experiences. The demand for beauty has also continued to increase, and skin care products have become an indispensable necessity for most people's daily lives. The purpose of this study was to try to understand the relationship between the relationship aesthetics of the skin care products service personnel and the service climate and customer satisfaction. A total of 450 valid questionnaires were collected. All have significant and positive correlations. The service climate also shows a significant positive correlation with customer satisfaction. Some of the interference effects only improve the climate of innovation and have an interfering effect on the relationship between after-sales service and overall brand satisfaction. Service climate is also a service for skin care products. The relationship between personnel aesthetics and customer satisfaction has some mediating effects. This study expects the result of the aesthetics of the relationship between the skin care service personnel and the service personnel of the future skin care products brand to provide higher quality services to customer needs when providing services.
關鍵字: 保養品服務人員|關係美學|服務氣候|顧客滿意度|service personnel of skin care products|relational aesthetics|service climate|customer satisfaction

主要篇名: 迺夜市！觀光夜市之目的地意象、觀光吸引力、遊憩涉入對滿意度與重遊意願之影響
並列篇名: Destination Image, Tourism Attraction, Recreation Involvement toward Satisfaction and Revisiting Willingness of Kaohsiung Ruifeng Night Market
作者: 劉嘉麒=Liu, Chia-Chi|朱永蕙=Chu, Yung-Hui
主要摘要: 夜市，是台灣的觀光特色，亦具有觀光休閒的功能，並能提高觀光產業的經濟價值，促進台灣觀光及經濟的繁榮。本研究目的旨在探討遊客對於台灣高雄瑞豐夜市的目的地意象、觀光吸引力與遊憩涉入對顧客滿意度及重遊意願之影響。本研究採立意抽樣之問卷調查，並以瑞豐夜市遊客為主要研究對象，有效回收樣本318份。研究結果顯示，目的地意象、觀光吸引力與遊憩涉入對顧客滿意度皆有正向顯著影響；再者，目的地意象與顧客滿意度對重遊意願亦有正向顯著影響。儘管遊憩涉入與觀光吸引力對重遊意願無顯著影響，但是皆能藉由顧客滿意度對重遊意願產生間接效果，而具有完全中介效果。最後，本研究提供學術與實務之意涵做為參考建議。
並列摘要: Night markets are one of the distinguishing features for sightseeing in Taiwan. It also functions as leisure to stimulate economic prosperity. The purpose of this study is to investigate the influences among destination image, tourism attraction, recreation involvement satisfaction and revisiting willingness of Kaohsiung Ruifeng night market. Purposive sampling was applied for the survey. 318 valid samples have been collected. Results have shown that destination image, tourism attraction and recreation involvement all have positive significant influence on satisfaction; additionally, both destination image and satisfaction have positive significant influence on revisiting willingness. Even though both recreation involvement and tourism attraction have no significant influence on revisiting willingness, both recreation involvement and tourism attraction have complete mediation effect on revisiting willingness via satisfaction. At last, this study provides suggestions for academic purposes and industries.

主要篇名: 禮多人不怪？！：探討過度服務對服務接觸與服務結果之干擾效果
並列篇名: Courtesy Costs Nothing?!: Exploring the Moderation Effect of Over-Attentive Service on the Service Encounter toward Service Outcome
作者: 楊主行=Yang, Chu-Hsing|劉嘉麒=Liu, Chia-Chi
主要摘要: 近年來，由於服務業在市場上具有不可忽視的重要性，因此，服務業之間相繼推出的服務水準越來越高，甚至超過原本顧客的期望。本研究的目的主要是探討服務業的過度服務表現在服務接觸、顧客情緒與服務結果的關係鏈中，對於顧客的干擾影響效果。本研究以王品集團旗下四家西堤牛排西餐店的顧客為研究對象，共收集441份有效問卷。研究結果顯示，服務接觸到顧客情緒與服務結果的關係鏈均呈現正向顯著影響。過度服務的表現均會負向顯著干擾影響從服務接觸到顧客情緒與服務結果之間的關係效果；另外，透過Johnson－Neyman技巧細部檢測干擾的發生點，當顧客對於過度服務的感受在普通至有點同意的時候，干擾效果即達顯著水準。其結果表示，當顧客對於過度服務的負面感受到一定的程度時，則過度服務對於服務接觸至服務結果的過程中，具有顯著削弱關係的效果。最後，本研究提供重要管理意涵與未來研究方向。
並列摘要: In recent, the service industry has a significant importance in the market, and service level between service industries is getting higher and higher, even exceeding customer expectations. This article examines the moderation effect of over-attentive service among the service encounter, customer emotion, and service outcome. Our data were collected via four TASTY steak restaurants survey of 441 participants. The results showed service encounter were positive significantly toward customer emotion and service outcome. Customer emotion was also positive significantly toward service outcome. In addition, our study examines the moderation effect via Johnson - Neyman technique, and the over-attentive service was significantly moderating the relationship among the service encounter, customer emotion, and service outcome. The results indicated that the decline effect was happened in relationship between service encounter and service outcome When the customer feels the critical point for the negative of over-attentive service. Finally, we present implications and future directions for research and practice related to service industries.
關鍵字: 過度服務|服務接觸|顧客情緒|服務結果|over-attentive service|service encounter|customer emotion|service outcome

主要篇名: 共享經濟平台之資訊不對稱、信任及購買意願：以聲譽及評價機制作為干擾變數
並列篇名: Information Asymmetry, Trust, and Purchase Intention in Sharing Economy Platforms - Reputation and the Feedback Mechanism as Moderators
作者: 宋峻豪=Sung, Jun-Hao|王昱凱=Wang, Yu-Kai
主要摘要: 本研究係以共享經濟平台為情境，提出影響購買意願之整合模型並進行驗證。本研究共收集198份有效問卷，並透過結構方程式進行驗證，實證結果大致上支持本研究之假說。本研究之主要貢獻，係協助我們進一步了解在共享經濟平台情境下，資訊不對稱與信任之關係，亦即，不同於傳統上的觀點認為對供給者的資訊不對稱會負向影響需求者對供給者的信任，本研究發現由於共享經濟平台的加入，需求者預期共享經濟平台將對供給者進行篩選及讓供給者上架產生之認可效果，將使對供給者的資訊不對稱對供給者的信任產生正向影響信任，此一發現展現共享經濟平台情境對資訊不對稱與信任之影響。此外，有別於過去研究著重在探究聲譽及評價機制的直接效果，本研究也協助我們了解，聲譽及評價機制如何在購買意願整合模型產生干擾效果。最後，本研究提出管理意涵與建議，提供平台之供給者作為提高需求者購買意願之參考依據。
並列摘要: In the context of sharing economy platforms, this study offers and empirically tests an integrated model to explore the antecedents of purchase intention. By conducting a survey of 198 subjects and analyzing by structural equation modeling, this study's empirical results largely support the hypotheses. The findings contribute by helping us better understand the relationship between information asymmetry and trust in the context of sharing economy platforms. Contrary to the traditional viewpoint that information asymmetry favoring suppliers negatively impacts trust in the suppliers, this study finds a positive influence in this particular setting. This reflects that users expect that sharing economy platforms select and allow proper suppliers to offer their goods and services on the platforms and thus generate endorsement effects by adding the role of sharing economy platforms. This study adds to prior research that focuses on the direct effects of reputation and the feedback mechanism by enhancing our knowledge on how reputation and the feedback mechanism act as moderators in an integrated model on purchase intention. Practical implications and suggestions based on these findings are discussed.

主要篇名: Instagram使用動機對品牌參與之影響：以廣告價值為中介變數
並列篇名: Examining the Effects of Motivational Usage for Instagram on Brand Engagement: The Mediating Role of Advertising Value
作者: 陳冠儒=Kuan-Ju Chen|趙家彤=Chao, Chia-Tung
主要摘要: 本研究之目的為探討社群媒體 Instagram的使用動機對於品牌參與之影響，以及廣告價值在使用動機與品牌參與之間的關係所產生的中介效果。研究對象選定18至30歲的年輕Instagram使用者為目標族群，採用問卷調查的研究方法，共回收288份有效問卷。研究結果發現，五項使用動機：品牌隸屬、機會尋求、對話性、娛樂性、調查性對消費者的品牌參與皆有顯著影響，且出現在Instagram上贊助式廣告的廣告價值在此影響中皆存在部分中介效果。本研究於學術上運用使用與滿足理論來解釋Instagram使用對消費者品牌參與的影響；實務上則可作為品牌或企業制定社群媒體行銷策略之參考。
並列摘要: The purposes of this study are to explore the effects of motivational usage for Instagram on brand engagement and to examine the mediating effects of advertising value in the relationships between motivational usage and brand engagement. A survey research method targeting Instagram users at the age between 18 and 30 was employed. The results (N=288) showed that the five motivations, including brand affiliation, opportunity seeking, conversation, entertainment, and investigation, for using Instagram had significant influences on brand engagement, while advertising value of sponsored content partially mediated the above mentioned influences. Theoretically, this study contributes to the application of uses and gratification theory in the social media realm. It also provides suggestions for brands or corporates to develop effective social media marketing strategies managerially.

主要篇名: 桌球競賽現場觀眾觀賞動機與行為意圖關係之研究－以服務品質滿意度為中介
並列篇名: A Study on the Relationship between Audience's Motivation and Behavior Intention of Spectators in the Table Tennis Match - Intermediate Service Quality Satisfaction
主要摘要: 本研究主要目的在於瞭解桌球競賽現場觀眾的觀賞動機、滿意度及行為意圖之關係。採用問卷調查法，以2017世界大學運動會桌球賽現場觀眾為對象，共獲得有效問卷595份。以描述性統計分析觀眾之背景組成，皮爾森積差相關分析及階層迴歸分析檢驗觀賞動機、滿意度及行為意圖之中介效果。研究結果發現，世大運桌球觀眾組成在性別及年齡方面並無太大的差異，但過去無桌球運動經驗的觀眾佔多數。其次，滿意度會部分中介觀賞動機與行為意圖。
並列摘要: The main purpose of this study is to understand the audience's viewing motivation, satisfaction and behavioral intentions of the table tennis game. A questionnaire survey was conducted on the audience of the 2017 Summer Universidad table tennis tournament. A total of 595 valid questionnaires were obtained. Descriptive statistics were used to analyze the background composition of the audience. Pearson's polynomial correlation analysis and hierarchical regression analysis were used to examine the mediating effects of ornamental motivation, satisfaction, and behavioral intentions. The study found that there is not much difference in the gender and age of the spectators in the World Games, but the majority of audiences who had no experience in table tennis exercise in the past. Second, satisfaction will partially mediate the viewing motives and behavioral intentions.

主要篇名: 促進在地認同之社群網站溝通模式研究－以大鵬灣水上嘉年華活動為例
並列篇名: Online Interaction for Social Network Websites to Enhance Locial Identity: A Case of Promoting Dapeng Bay Waterfornt Cartival Activities
作者: 黃錦祥=Huang, Jin-Shiang|王馨葦=Wang, Hsin-Wei|王大瑾=Wang, Da-Jinn
主要摘要: 在地認同對發揚地方文化傳承至關重要。Web 2.0已成為現代社會溝通交流的重要平台，透過虛擬社群進行在地訊息分享與情感交流，不僅能凝聚在地方意識，也能促進在地文化的認同。本研究以大鵬灣水上嘉年華活動為文化活動標的，藉由研究者透過專家訪談方式蒐集資料，以瞭解在地節慶活動之社群網站經營方法。並從推敲可能性模式的觀點，探索中央路徑與邊陲路徑，如何對線上互動與說服過程產生社群說服的效果。在理論貢獻上，建立了網路社群互動與說服過程如何影響在地意識形成與發展的觀點；在實務貢獻上，也能提供使本地居民與外來遊客對大鵬灣金三角地區在地認同提升的虛擬社群經營策略。
並列摘要: Local identity plays an essential role in promoting local culture and heritages. Web2.0 has been widely accepted as a communication platform in a modern society. Sharing information and emotions through virtual community can not only aggregate local awareness but also promote the recognition of local culture. In this study, we discuss the influence of online interaction on the recognition of local waterfront carnival activities and cultural identity through official and private websites for promoting Dapeng Bay area. This research adopts interviews to understand the communication efforts of two discinct websites. By applying Elaboration Likelihood Model possibility of the model, we verified how the central path and the peripheral path influence online interaction and persuasion process, and thus affect the local cultural identity of the virtual community members. Our results offered a theoretical viewpoint to explain the influence of online interaction and persuasion process on the formation and development of local awareness. In practical contributions, our findings would provide insights into forming virtual community strategies to enhance the feeling of local identity in Dapeng Bay Golden Triangle district for local residents and foreign tourists.

主要篇名: 高爾夫球運動行銷策略與趨勢
並列篇名: Golf Marketing Strategy and the Trend
主要摘要: 透過高爾夫球運動參與，可認識新朋友與不同產業的參與者，並進一步藉由高爾夫運動此社交管道與其他公司或產業進行同業結盟或異業聯盟。高爾夫球運動的優點包括骨骼肌肉、神經系統、呼吸與循環系統等生理與心理層面均有正向的影響，由此可知高爾夫球運動參與者動機多元，探討行銷策略有其重要性，因此本文目的為分析高爾夫球行銷策略與趨勢以利達成高爾夫球運動之永續發展。本文研究方法為文獻探討，結果發現高爾夫球運動行銷策略主要為球場對消費者進行果嶺與會員證優惠行銷，另外透過電子商務公司銷售全球高爾夫球場聯盟使用會籍以及高爾夫網站社群等；其中，透過全球高爾夫球場聯盟銷售使用會籍、臉書與Line社群網站的行銷是目前的趨勢。本文建議高爾夫球產業的營運仰賴適當的行銷策略，需注意人口規模與成長趨勢，不停求新求變與修正行銷策略，營利才足以永續。
並列摘要: Golf participants not only can meet new friends from different industries but also make the commercial deals or alliances by this social platform. The advantages of golf activities including the physical positive effects for the individual's bone, muscle, neural system, respiratory system, circulatory system, and mental health. The diverse motivation of the participants makes analyzing golf marketing strategy important. Therefore the purposes of this article are to analysis the golf marketing strategies and the trends for the future sustainable development. The research method of this article is literature review and the results are as following: the main marketing strategy is from the golf court to the customer by marketing discount membership and green fee; secondly, through E-commerce selling reciprocal play program international membership; as well as through social media to marketing. Among all, through E-commerce selling international membership and marketing through social media, such as Face book and Line are the trend for the golf-marketing strategy selection. For future recommendations, golf industry's sustainability relies on compatible marketing strategies with the changes of the participants' demographics' background. Continually to make adjustments for the changes would make the profit solid.

主要篇名: Pursuing Sustainability through Perceived Behavioral Control: Discussing Distinct Effects of Self-Consciousness and Self-Identity on Anti-Consumption
並列篇名: 透過知覺行為控制發展永續性行為：以自我意識和自我認同探討反消費行為
作者: 欒紀成=Chi-Cheng Luan|林建宏=Chien-Hung Lin
主要摘要: Sustainable consumption has been increasingly popular since sustainable development becomes a beneficial concept for all humans. Anti-consumption, highly related to sustainable consumption, refers to rejecting less sustainable products. Intuitively, anti-consumption is driven from self-perception with considering the environment or society. Little research, however, discussed psychological processes of anti-consumption based on factors with only considering self. Thus, this research focused on discussing the effect of perceived behavioral control from the theory of planned behavior and self-control theory, which has been prevalently used in sustainable consumption, to develop a theoretical model regarding two distinct effects on anti-consumption in terms of self-consciousness and self-identity. Using structural equation modeling to analyze the data via online survey, the results showed that personal identity driven by private self-consciousness tends to positively affect perceived behavioral control over anti-consumption, whereas social identity has only a directly positive effect on behavioral intentions toward anti-consumption. This type of perceived control has a positive influence on behavioral intentions toward anti-consumption. These findings suggested that marketers can promote sustainable products, corporate social responsibility, or any events regarding sustainable development by differentiating self-identity in two consumer segments. In terms of promotional strategies about communication campaigns, marketers or policymakers can enhance self-benefit to stimulate consumers' perceived behavioral control over more sustainable behavior in addition to public-benefit.
並列摘要: 自從永續概念發展成為人類認知有益的觀念以來，永續性消費行為已越來越受歡迎。反消費行為與永續消費高度相關，反消費行為代表拒絕消費不太具有永續性的產品。反消費行為受對環境或社會的自我認知所驅動著。然而，較少有研究透過以自我認知的因素來討論反消費的心理過程。因此，本研究的重點是從計劃行為理論和自我控制理論中，加以探討知覺行為控制對反消費行為的影響。反消費行為已廣泛應用於永續消費的分析中。本研究模型分析自我意識和自我認同兩種不同路徑對反消費行為的影響，並以結構方程模型分析線上所調查的資料，結果顯示透過自我意識所驅動的個人認同會正向影響自我知覺控制，進而產生反消費行為；而社會認同對反消費行為僅有產生直接影響的效果。知覺控制對反消費行為意圖具有正向的影響。本研究建議行銷人員在推廣永續產品時，透過企業社會責任或跟永續發展有關的事件來面對此兩類自我認同的消費群體進行推廣；對於傳播的策略方面建議，行銷人員或政策制定者可以透過增強消費者的自我利益，以刺激其知覺行為控制，進而產生除公共利益之外的更多永續行為。

主要篇名: 品牌知名度與綠色消費認知對低碳旅遊套裝行程的知覺品質之影響－兼論產品知識的干擾效果
並列篇名: The Effects of Brand Awareness and Perception of Green Consumption on Perceived Quality of Low-Carbon Package Tours-With a Study in the Moderating Effect of Product Knowledge
作者: 陳冠仰=Kuan-Yang Chen|蕭至惠=Chih-Hui Hsiao|汪益民=Yi-Ming Wang
主要摘要: 本研究旨在探討品牌知名度與綠色消費認知對低碳旅遊套裝行程的知覺品質之關係。本研究採便利抽樣法，針對大學生進行施測並共回收276份有效問卷。研究結果顯示：（1）品牌知名度對知覺品質有正向影響。（2）綠色消費認知對知覺品質有正向影響。（3）在旅行社的品牌知名度與產品知覺品質之間，消費者產品知識的高／低具有干擾作用。（4）在高產品知識的影響下，品牌知名度高／低對產品知覺品質沒有顯著差異；反之，在低產品知識影響下，高品牌知名度的產品知覺品質高於低品牌知名度。（5）知覺品質對綠色購買意願有正向影響。最後，針對本研究之結果也提供幾項管理意涵，供業界實務管理者參考。
並列摘要: The purpose of this study is to explore the relationships among brand awareness, the perception of green consumption with the moderating role of product knowledge on perceived quality for low-carbon package tours. By convenience sampling, this study collected a total of 276 college students' questionnaires and examined using empirical analysis. The results indicated that: (1) Brand awareness has a positive influence on perceived quality. (2) The perception of green consumption has a positive influence on perceived quality. (3) High/low consumers' product knowledge has a moderating effect in the relationships between the brand awareness and perceived quality. (4) Under the high product knowledge, high/low brand awareness has no different influence on perceived quality. Under the low product knowledge, perceived quality of high brand awareness is higher than low brand awareness. (5) Consumers' perceived quality has a positive influence on green buying intention. Finally, this study also provides several practical implications and future directions for managers.

主要篇名: 積極人格與地方依附之研究：文化體驗與負責任環境行為的調節中介模式
並列篇名: Proactive Personality and Place Attachment: A Moderated Mediation of Cultural Experience and Responsible Environmental Behavior
作者: 林建信=Chien-Hsin Lin|蔡明翰=Ming-Han Tsai
主要摘要: 節慶觀光和文化旅遊成為近年熱門的觀光型態，遊客藉由文化體驗深入了解地方的歷史傳承與文化軌跡。本文目的在探討遊客的積極人格特質透過負責任環境行為影響地方依附之歷程，再驗證文化體驗對上述間接過程之調節效果。本研究以台中市清水地景藝術節之遊客為研究對象，獲得有效問卷262份。研究結果顯示：1、積極人格正向影響地方依附。2、負責任環境行為對積極人格和地方依附有中介效果。3、文化體驗負向調節積極人格對地方依附的正向影響。4、文化體驗正向調節負責任環境行為對積極人格和地方依附的中介效果。研究成果對理論與實務之意涵為：1、文化體驗強化積極人格對地方依附之直接效果，卻弱化積極人格經由負責任環境行為對地方依附之間接效果。2、相關管理單位應結合地方特色，規劃完整文化體驗行銷策略。3、可經常舉辦一系列愛護地方環境之環保活動，以提高遊客對地方之依附。
並列摘要: Festival and cultural tourism have become popular tourist patterns in recent years. Visitors can have a deep understanding of the historical heritage and cultural trace through cultural experience. The purpose of this study is to research whether the tourists with proactive personality will improve place attachment through responsible environmental behavior. Furthermore, to analyze the moderated mediation effect of cultural experience on the relationship between proactive personality and place attachment. The study focused on the tourists who had participated the Qingshui Land Art Festival in the Taichung City. Totals of 262 valid questionnaires were collected. Based on the research findings: 1. Proactive personality positively affected place attachment. 2. Responsible environmental behavior has mediating effect in the relationship between proactive personality and place attachment. 3. Cultural experience moderates the relationship between proactive personality and place attachment. 4. Cultural experience has moderated mediation effect between proactive personality and place attachment. Based on the results above, some theoretical and practical implications are proposed: 1.Cultural experience can strengthen the direct effect of proactive personality on place attachment, but weaken the indirect effect of proactive personality on place attachment through responsible environmental behavior. 2.Combining with local features, the public sector need to develop a completely cultural experience marketing strategy. 3.To increase visitors' place attachment, a series of activities need to be conducted concerning environmental protection.

主要篇名: 休閒型實況主的來源可信度、直播環境氛圍對目標視聽眾知覺價值影響之研究
並列篇名: Study of Source Credibility of the Casual Live Streamers and Impact of Streaming Environment Atmosphere on Audiences' Perceived Value
作者: 賴明政=Ming-Cheng Lai|吳宗曄=Tsung-Yeh Wu|盧學瑩=Hsueh-Ying Lu
主要摘要: 隨著網路技術進步及創新，網路直播成為新的應用技術，而直播平台的產值呈大幅度倍數成長，電競的風潮結合了直播技術，帶動了遊戲實況產業的蓬勃發展。過去遊戲廠商都是藉由明星、名人等進行代言，但近日趨勢有所改變，實況主成為遊戲廠商偏好的代言對象，實況平台也漸漸成為廣告商投放廣告的目標市場。故本研究透過對於遊戲實況不同涉入程度的目標視聽眾，其來源可信度、環境氛圍、知覺價值與購買意願之關係進行討論。在PTT上以非隨機便利抽樣方式發放。研究發現：1.實況主的吸引力、專業性及實況直播時的環境氛圍都會顯著而正向的影響目標視聽眾的知覺價值。2.知覺價值會顯著正向影響購買意願。3.目標視聽眾的涉入程度會正向強化實況主的專業性對知覺價值的影響。研究結果有助於實況平台實務上，研擬未來發展方向時的參考，也對實況主直播情境提出具體之建議，並藉此實證研究與發現或可擴增或補強現今對於實況直播平台及實況主特性等研究議題的不足。
並列摘要: As the advancement and innovation of network technology, live steam has become a new application of technology. This also soared the production value of live stream platforms. Though integrating the trend of eSport and live stream technology, the gaming industry has flourished in recent years. In the past, game companies looked for celebrities for endorsement; however, these companies favor streamers these days. Streaming platforms gradually become new targets where more marketers are putting their adverts. This study focuses on the relationship between source credibility, environment atmosphere, perceived value and purchase intention toward different audience involvement. This study finds out 1. Attractiveness and expertise of a streamer and the streaming atmosphere have positive and notable influence on determining audiences' perceived value. 2. Perceived value positively affects audiences' purchase intention. 3. Audience involvement positively enhances the streamer's expertise on the impacts of perceived value. This study can be helpful for dealing with implementation of streaming platforms and regarded as a reference for future development. This study can also provide constructive suggestions to the streaming environment, and hence make up for the insufficiency of current study regarding streaming platforms and streamers' characteristics at present.

主要篇名: 群眾募資平台行銷大數據分析研究
並列篇名: Research on Big Data Analysis of Fundraising Platform
作者: 郭迺鋒=Nai-Fong Kuo|姚成彥=Chen-Yen Yao|李穎思=Ying-Si Li
主要摘要: 募資平台的出現，改善舊有的創業投資者草創時期所面臨的問題。傳統創業募資大都採用銀行貸款，創業者很難與投資人取得接觸。再者，創業申請的過程瑣碎繁雜，取得資金後的變數多，常造成出資贊助方與創業者方兩者關係緊張。出資者對創業者不了解，出現許多不確定性的問題。而募資平台改善溝通管道，讓創投業者能與投資者方便接觸，更快速取得資金，讓新創業者在創業初期有好的開始。募資網站的出現對創投業者也是一大福音，減少投資人的風險。本研究主要針對Crunchbase網站成立的前後，分析各個產業的募資情況，包含所在募資的地區、募資期間所募資到的金額、公司募資時的情況等。針對不同情況下，分析兩個時間的差異性以及如何選擇地方或是參考哪些產業去做新創投資的目標等。本研究顯示網站成立後，募資活動大幅增加；不同地區募資金額來說，以美國佔了最大宗；而募資時間的長短不會因為時間長所能募集到的資金就多，可能還包含產業本身產品或其他因素等；而大部分的業者都是屬於再募資情況，首次公開發行募資所佔比例約只有10%的比重，慎選地區或是產業類型是創投的關鍵。
並列摘要: The emergence of a fundraising platform has improved the problems faced by the old entrepreneurial investors during the grassroots period. Most traditional entrepreneurial fundraising uses bank loans, making it difficult for entrepreneurs to get in touch with investors. Moreover, the process of applying for a business is trivial and complicated, and there are many variables after obtaining funds, which often causes tension between the sponsors and the entrepreneurs. The funder does not understand the entrepreneur and there are many uncertainties. The fundraising platform improves communication channels, allowing venture capitalists to have easy access to investors and faster access to capital, so that new entrepreneurs can start well in the early stages of their business. The emergence of fundraising websites is also a great boon for venture capitalists, reducing the risk of investors. This study mainly analyzes the fundraising situation of each industry before and after the establishment of the Crunchbase website, including the area where the fundraising is raised, the amount of funds raised during the fundraising period, and the situation when the company raises funds. For different situations, analyze the differences between the two times and how to choose a place or refer to which industries to target new ventures. This study shows that after the establishment of the website, the fundraising activities have increased significantly; the amount of funds raised in different regions is the largest in the United States; and the length of the fundraising period will not be raised because of the long time, and may also include The industry itself or other factors; and most of the players are re-funding, the proportion of initial public offerings is only about 10%, carefully selected regions or industry types are the key to venture capital.

主要篇名: 隨物共創：密室逃脫浮現的團隊互動
並列篇名: Co-create Bricolage by Objects: Emergent Interactions in Teams of Escape Room Games
作者: 陳蕙芬=Hui-Fen Chen|林彥甫=Yan-Fu Lin
主要摘要: 當資源有限與急迫任務時，團隊要如何發揮創造力解決難題？該表現出哪些互動？如何善用手邊資源進行共創？這些經常考驗團隊在資源掌握的主動性與團隊的合作能力，且不同團隊之表現不同，有的團隊能快速運用取得的資源、解決問題，有的團隊則會陷入困境、導致任務失敗。本研究深入了解團隊在急迫任務所展現的行為能力、團隊互動的形態與變化、物件的辨識與使用，探討在擬真情境下，團隊如何回應挑戰。本研究以質性研究法，選擇密室逃脫遊戲為研究場域，分析闖關團隊行為。從團隊互動與物件的角度切入，本研究發現歸納出團隊三種互動型態與後續物件的運用，勾勒出引發團隊隨創進而能共創的要素。本研究發現團隊不能漠視成員間互動的重要性，而善用提問技巧更能激發出成員的隨創行為，有助於在資源有限下完成急迫任務。由此新觀點也引出本研究在理論與實務上的貢獻。
並列摘要: The study aims to explore how the team respond to the challenges of rush tasks with limited resources effectively. How do the team solve problems with creativity collectively? What interaction do the team present? How do the team use the resources on hand to co-create? The challenges mentioned above examine the initiative and cooperative capabilities of teams. To respond the issues, this study collected qualitative data from observations and interviews to investigate the interactions and the use of objects in team settings-specifically escape room games, which combine limited resources, urgent situations, and need for problem-solving skills. The study adopted qualitative research method and collected data of real team cases. The findings suggest that the importance of interactions between team members and summarize the keys to trigger the bricolage behavior to co-create values in a team. The theoretical and practical implications are discussed based on the findings. The findings contribute to the practices of Taiwanese small and middle enterprises and those fields depend on the performances of teams.

主要篇名: 從行為透視模型探討影響衝動性購買之行為觀點、人格特質及產品效益之因素
並列篇名: Discussing the Factors Affecting Impulsive Purchasing with Behavioral Perspective, Personality Traits and Product Benefits
作者: 陳冠仰=Kuan-Yang Chen|蕭至惠=Chih-Hui Hsiao|林廉凱=Lain-Kai Lin
主要摘要: 環顧過去文獻，尚無相關研究情境探討消費者身處於大型國際旅展的情境中，誘發消費者的衝動性購買行為的影響因素，本文以「行為透視模型」概念為基礎，提出衝動性購買影響因素的歸納原則，分為「內在刺激」、「外在刺激」與「產品價值」三構面及9項影響因素，並運用模糊層級程序分析法進行重要性分析。研究結果如下：（1）消費者產生衝動性購買時，「內在刺激」與「產品價值」二構面對消費者的重要性，明顯高於「外在刺激」構面。（2）高低衝動性人格特質族群間，兩個族群中受「外在刺激」線索影響為最，但是在「內在刺激」與「產品價值」方面的影響則不一致。至於易受人際間影響特質族群間，低度受人際間影響族群受內在刺激線索影響為最；高度受人際間影響族群受產品價值線索影響為最。無論是功利型效益或是娛樂型效益消費者皆受「外在刺激」線索影響為最。本文不僅為衝動性購買之影響因素提供了量化的佐證數據，亦有助於日後企業界拓展行銷活動。
並列摘要: Reviewing the past literatures, there is no relevant research to explore the factors that influence consumers' impulsive buying behaviors in the situations of large international travel shows. This study proposed three dimensions categorizing the motivators of impulse buying (IB) based on Behavioral Perspective Model, namely ＂internal stimuli＂, ＂external stimuli＂, and ＂product value＂, including 9 motivators. Through the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process analysis, the results are as follow. (1) The two dimensions, ＂internal stimuli＂ and ＂product value＂ have higher importance than ＂external stimuli＂. (2) Among the IB groups with high and low impulsive personality traits, the ＂ external stimuli ＂ clue was the most affected in the two groups. For susceptibility to interpersonal influence, those with low interpersonal influence are most affected by internal stimuli cues; those with high interpersonal influence are most affected by product value. Finally, whether IBs are utilitarian or entertainment oriented customers, they are most affected by the ＂external stimulus＂ clues. The current study provides not only quantitative analyses about the importance degree of the dimensions and motivators of IB, but also useful information for future research such as development of business marketing activities.

主要篇名: 連鎖體系營運支持與加盟者知覺組織支持對加盟者續約意圖影響之研究－以滿意度為中介變項及正向獎勵為干擾變項
並列篇名: The Impact of Competitive Resources on Retention Intention in Franchise System-The Mediating and Moderating Roles of Satisfaction and Rewards
作者: 余俊杰=Chun-Chieh Yu|蔡顯童=Hsien-Tung Tsai
主要摘要: 在特許經營模式中，加盟者與連鎖體系之間的穩定關係是連鎖體系持續成長的基石。本研究基於資源基礎觀點，提出連鎖體系的核心競爭資源（core competitive resources）對於加盟者續約意圖的影響關係。本研究分為兩階段研究；首先，藉由文獻回顧，探討學理基礎；並遴選七位具有連鎖加盟實務經驗的總部主管及加盟者，進行深度質性訪談，據以建立觀念性模型；其次，蒐集493位加盟者之問卷樣本，以量化數據驗證本研究之論點。分析結果發現連鎖體系競爭資源，包含，連鎖體系提供之「品牌聲譽」、「後勤服務」及「營業效能」為加盟者所需的營運支持資源；以及，連鎖總部與督導機制在提供管控及輔導協助時，加盟者所感受之知覺組織支持，並區分為「知覺總部支持」及「知覺督導支持」兩個子構念，均為加盟者續約意圖的關鍵前置因素。各項競爭資源因素透過加盟者「滿意度」之中介效果，進而影響加盟者的「續約意圖」。在統計驗證上，也發現在「知覺督導支持」對「滿意度」的影響關係上，存在二次項非線性影響（quadratic nonlinear effect）；同時，本研究也確認「正向獎勵」的非強制性獎勵措施，在該非線性影響關係上，具有負向調節作用。研究結果深化過去連鎖加盟學理，釐清連鎖體系競爭資源對續約意圖的影響機制；並於實務意涵上，提供連鎖加盟產業實務運作之管理建議。
並列摘要: The retention intention of existing franchisees is the crucial factor to stable the development of the franchise system. Based on resources-based views, this study suggests that the franchisor's competitive resources, such as brand reputation, logistics services, business efficacy, perceived headquarter support, and perceived supervisor support, will affect the franchisee retention intention. This research carries out in two stages. Firstly, it hypothesized a basic model on resources and relationship theories. Besides, we recruited seven interviewees with ample experience in franchisors or franchisees for collecting their insights by qualitative research and developing the model. Secondly, we gather 493 franchisee questionnaire data in Taiwan and examine this model utilizing bootstrapping regression. This study found: (1) The overall satisfaction of franchisees mediates the relationship between the franchisor's competitive resources and franchisee's retention intention; (2) The curvilinear relationship between perceived supervisor support of franchisee and the overall satisfaction is U-shaped; and (3) Reward moderates the relationship between perceived supervisor support and overall satisfaction. This study initially finds and discusses the nonlinear relationship between the perceived supervisor support and overall satisfaction through quadratic regressions analysis.

主要篇名: 食品廣告中健康宣稱的訊息框架對高齡者購買意願之影響
並列篇名: The Influence of The Message Framing in Food Product Advertising on Senior Consumer's Purchase Intention
作者: 劉智淇=Chih-Chi Liu|林鴻洲=Hung-Chou Lin
主要摘要: 我國在高齡者食品廣告行銷、消費資訊的議題上，高齡消費者在購買食品時確實有機會受到產品資訊影響購買意願。在高齡者可能對產品及廣告的瞭解不足的前提下，廣告詞句中所使用的訊息框架更有機會影響高齡者的購買意願。本研究希望瞭解影響高齡者購買意願的廣告因素，以食品廣告中正、反面訊息框架下的健康宣稱為主，加入代言人做為調節變項。研究採實驗法，分為兩個實驗，實驗一提供不同的廣告訊息框架（正面、反面）施測，探討使用不同訊息框架下高齡者購買意願的差別；實驗二採2（訊息框架：正面、反面）2（代言人：名人、素人）組間設計，透過訊息框架與代言人的操弄，探討四組廣告對高齡者購賣意願影響的差別。實驗一施測85份有效樣本結果顯示食品廣告中正面訊息對高齡消費者的購買意願有正向影響；實驗二施測122份有效樣本結果顯示代言人對食品廣告中正、反面訊息與高齡消費者購買意願間有調節效果：以名人作為食品廣告中正面健康宣稱的代言人時，對高齡消費者的購買意願比使用反面訊息高，以素人作為代言人時則無差異。本研究希望增加食品廣告訊息應用的效益，並為針對高齡者為目標族群的產品提供行銷實務建議。
並列摘要: On the issues of food marketing and consumption information for the elderly, according to the government's 2016 survey report, senior consumers do have the opportunity to be affected by product information when purchasing food. Under the premise that older people may not have enough knowledge about products and advertisements, the positive and negative messages used in the advertising phrases are more likely to affect the elderly 's willingness to buy. This study hopes to understand the advertising factors that affect the purchase intention of the elderly. Taking the message framing of health claims in food ads as the main, adding endorsers as moderation variables.  This study uses experimental methods. The results of this study showed that Frist, positive messages in food advertisements have a positive impact on senior consumers ' purchase intention. Second, Endorsers has a regulatory effect on the positive and negative messages in food advertisements and the purchase intention of senior consumers. When celebrities are used as endorsers for positive health claims in food advertisements, the purchase intention of the senior consumers is higher than the use of negative messages. This research hopes to increase the effectiveness of the application of food advertising messages and provide practical marketing recommendations for products targeting the elderly as the target group.

主要篇名: 限量商品對消費者知覺價值及購買意願之影響：探討產品類型、涉入程度、人格特質之調節效果
並列篇名: The influence of Product Scarcity on Consumers' Perceived Value and Purchase Intention: Moderated by Product Type, Involvement and Personality
作者: 林育則=Yu-Tse Lin|趙柏宇=Po-Yu Chao
主要摘要: 市場上不時可見到限量的促銷策略，這種策略能夠滿足消費者的獨特性需求，提升產品的價值，並增加消費者想要擁有的慾望。本研究透過實驗法蒐集366份有效樣本，探討不同的產品稀少性對於消費者知覺價值與購買意願的影響，並檢驗產品類型、涉入程度、人格特質的調節效果，以提出較有效之適配條件。研究結果顯示，在產品稀少性方面，供給稀少（時間）與需求稀少（數量）會讓消費者產生較高的知覺價值與購買意願。在產品類型方面，供給稀少（數量）搭配實用型產品或象徵型產品，會讓消費者產生較高的知覺價值與購買意願。在產品涉入程度方面，供給稀少（時間）與供給稀少（數量）會讓產品涉入程度高的消費者產生較高的知覺價值與購買意願。在人格特質方面，供給稀少（數量）會讓獨特性消費者產生較高的知覺價值與購買意願，需求稀少（數量）會讓從眾性消費者產生較高的知覺價值與購買意願。
並列摘要: Scarcity marketing is a type of marketing technique that's based on the principle that people want what is difficult to obtain. We recruited 366 participants for an experiment designed to assess the effects of supply scarcity (in terms of time), supply scarcity (in terms of quantity) and demand scarcity (in terms of quantity) on consumers' perceived value and purchase intension. Results indicate that under supply scarcity (in terms of time) and demand scarcity (in terms of quantity), consumers have higher perceived value and purchase intention. In the case of supply scarcity (in terms of quantity) with utilitarian products or symbolic products, consumers have higher perceived value and purchase intention. In terms of product involvement, consumers with high product involvement have higher perceived value and purchase intention under supply scarcity (in terms of time) and supply scarcity (in terms of quantity) condition. In the aspect of personality traits, for unique consumers, supply scarcity (in terms of quantity) were effective. For conformity consumers, demand scarcity (in terms of quantity) were the most effective.

主要篇名: Purchasing Behavior of Consumers in Taiwan's Organic Farmers' Markets - the Influence of Self-presentation and Altruism
並列篇名: 有機農夫市集消費者購買行為之研究－自我呈現及利他主義的影響
作者: Li-Wen Hsieh=謝立文|Wei-Li Hung=洪維勵|Tai-Hsi Wu=吳泰熙|Yi-An Pan=潘怡安
主要摘要: The study explored the influences of self-presentation, altruism, perceived value, and attitude on consumers' purchasing behavior at organic farmers' markets (FMs). A questionnaire survey was conducted in the FMs of three metropolitan areas, and a total of 438 valid questionnaires were collected. The results showed that both self-presentation and altruism had significant effects on the participating consumers' perceived values, and that these effects in turn affected their purchasing behavior by positively enhancing their attitudes towards the products of the organic FMs. The analysis also suggested that altruism is more important than self-presentation in predicting the perceived values of organic FM consumers, which implies that altruistic people will perceive higher values for the products of organic FMs, and that they will be willing to pay premium prices to support smallholder farmers and the sustainability of the environment.
並列摘要: 本研究從有機農夫市集消費者的角度，探討其自我呈現與利他主義對知覺價值、態度及購買行為之影響。本研究採問卷調查法，選取位於台北市、台中市及高雄市三大都會區有機農夫市集發放問卷，共計回收438份有效問卷。研究結果顯示，消費者的自我呈現與利他主義皆會正向顯著影響其知覺價值，這些影響會透過提升消費者對有機農夫市集的產品之正向態度，進而影響他們的購買行為。本研究結果亦發現，相較於自我呈現，利他主義對於知覺價值有較大的影響力，也就是說，較具利他性格的人會有較高的知覺價值，他們比較願意為了支持小農及保護環境，以較高的價格購買有機農夫市集的產品。

主要篇名: 體驗場景對忠誠度影響－以走馬瀨農場為例
並列篇名: Examining the Relationship between Experiencescape and Loyalty: The Case of Tsou Ma Lai Farm
作者: 李宗鴻=Tsung Hung Lee|楊佩怡=Pei-Yi Yang
主要摘要: 體驗場景涵蓋遊客在服務環境中所體會到的一切感覺、感受和經驗，廣泛應用於觀光休閒遊憩相關領域之研究中，本研究乃試圖建構體驗場景對忠誠度影響的理論模式。採自編問卷進行問卷調查，問卷內容包括體驗場景、態度忠誠度、行為忠誠度、及人口基本資料等四大部份。於2021年1月至2月間，以到走馬瀨休閒農場之遊客為研究對象，採系統抽樣方法，總共收集到430份有效問卷。利用LISREL 8.80進行驗證性因素分析及結構方程模式的實證研究。結果顯示，本研究的取樣資料與研究模式有良好的適配度，為一個可以接受的模式，研究模式有效的建構體驗場景對目的地忠誠度的影響模式。空間佈局和標牌、設備實用性、自然之三構面顯著的及正向的影響態度忠誠度；態度忠誠度顯著的及正向的影響行為忠誠度。最後，本研究提出「體驗場景－態度忠誠度－行為忠誠度」的理論模式及管理意涵，對休閒農場永續經營發展有潛在的貢獻。
並列摘要: The concept of experiencescape is widely used in the research of tourism, leisure and recreation related fields. This study aims to examine the relationship between experiencescape, attitudinal loyalty, and behavioral loyalty at Tsou Ma Lai Farm. Data collection was performed using on-site questionnaire surveys. A total of 430 valid samples were obtained. Descriptive statistics were analyzed using SPSS 24.0 for Windows and structural equation modeling was performed using LISREL 8.80 for Windows. The analytical results indicated that the ambient conditions, spatial layout and signs, and functionality of equipment positively and significantly affected attitudinal loyalty. Attitudinal loyalty positively and significantly affected behavioral loyalty. Finally, managerial implications and future research directions are provided.

主要篇名: 專家代言風格與多重來源代言之廣告效果
並列篇名: Advertising Effects of Expert Endorsement Styles and Multiple Source Endorsements
作者: 周軒逸=Hsuan-Yi Chou|李祐瑋=Yu-Wei Li
主要摘要: 近年食品和用品問題風波不斷，業者紛仰賴專家型代言人為產品背書，尤以醫師受到青睞，以增加消費者信任。本文結合語言強度理論、來源可信度模式、適配性假說、說服知識模型等理論，探討醫師代言人的代言風格、多重來源代言對廣告效果的影響，並檢視產品類型的干擾。兩個實驗的結果發現：（1）使用明確（vs.隱含）代言風格可產生較高的購買意願；（2）多角色呈現（vs.單一角色呈現）有較佳的產品態度；（3）功能性產品時，單純以醫師角色呈現且搭配明確代言，或是凸顯兼具消費者角色且搭配隱含代言效果較佳；在享樂性產品時，凸顯兼具消費者角色可提升廣告和產品態度；（4）多位（vs.單一）專家型代言人有較佳的廣告效果。研究結果對於專家代言具理論和實務貢獻。
並列摘要: In recent years, quite a few scandals related to the food and supply industry have gained publicity in Taiwan's market. Many businesses rely on expert spokespersons to endorse products so that consumer trust is increased; doctors are a popular choice for such expert endorsement. This paper combines the theoretical perspectives of language strength, the source credibility model, match-up hypothesis, and the persuasion knowledge model to examine how the endorsement style of doctors and multiple source endorsements affect advertising effectiveness. The moderating effect of product type is also examined. Experimental results reveal the following: (1) an explicit (vs. implicit) endorsement style generates higher consumer purchase intention; (2) multi-role (vs. single role) presentation leads to better product attitudes; (3) for utilitarian products, advertising effects are better in two scenarios: in an explicit endorsement when only the doctor role is presented and in an implicit endorsement when the consumer role of the doctor is also highlighted. For hedonic products, highlighting the doctor's consumer role can improve attitudes toward the advertisement and the product; (4) multiple (vs. single) endorsers acting as doctors yield better advertising effectiveness. The research results have theoretical and practical implications in expert endorsement.

主要篇名: The Influential Factors Associated with Travel Intention towards Eco-Tours: Moderating Role of Perceived Value
並列篇名: 探討影響遊客進行生態旅遊意願之因素：認知價值之調節角色
主要摘要: This study discusses the influences of environmental knowledge learning and travel value by applying the knowledge-attitude-behavior model, and aims to gain more insight into tourists' willingness to engage in eco-tours. Convenient sampling was used to extract 351 valid data from the survey. The second-order structural equation model with AMOS was used to examine the relations among the variables (environmental knowledge, environmental concern, attitudes toward eco-tours and behavioral intention), and the latent interaction method using double mean-centering was employed to evaluate the moderating role of travel value. The results indicate environmental knowledge positively affects environmental concern, attitudes toward eco-tours, and behavioral intention. Moreover, environmental concern also positively influences attitudes toward eco-tours and behavioral intention. Further, this study discusses the moderating effects of travel value (i.e., utilitarian value and hedonic value). The findings show utilitarian value can positively moderate the influence of environmental knowledge in tourists' behavioral intention. However, hedonic value negatively moderates the influences of environmental knowledge in tourist's behavioral intention.
並列摘要: 本研究應用知識－態度－行為模型之概念，整合環境知識、環境關注、生態旅遊態度、認知價值、旅遊意願等變數發展出研究架構，探討環境知識學習和旅遊價值對遊客生態旅遊行為的影響。本研究採用便利抽樣方法，透過問卷調查獲得351份有效樣本。首先針對環境知識、環境關注、生態旅遊態度與旅遊意願之間的關係，本研究採用二階結構方程模型來進行分析。認知價值在本研究以實用性價值與享樂性價值來進行調節變數之探討，其調節作用分析則採用雙重中心化之潛在交互作用的方法來進行。研究結果顯示環境知識可以對環境關注、生態旅遊態度和行為意圖產生正向的影響。環境關注也對生態旅遊態度和行為意圖有正向的影響。此外認知旅遊價值的調節作用結果也得到實用性價值會正向調節環境知識對遊客生態旅遊行為意圖的影響，而享樂性價值則會干擾環境知識對遊客生態旅遊行為意圖的影響。
關鍵字: eco-tours|environmental knowledge|environmental concern|perceived value|生態旅遊|環境知識|環境關注|認知價值

主要篇名: Facebook直播銷售的滿意度與購買意願之影響因素
並列篇名: The Influence Factors of Satisfaction and Purchase Intention on Facebook Live Streaming
作者: 曾紀幸=Chi-Hsing Tseng|郭信智=Hsin-Chih Kuo|林姿伶=Tzu-Ling Lin
主要摘要: Facebook從2016年開放直播以來，已成為小商家重要的行銷通路。如何提高直播銷售的滿意度與購買意願，是企業界關注的焦點。本研究以具有Facebook直播購物觀賞經驗者為對象，執行兩個調查，都是以網路問卷便利抽樣法來搜集資料。第一個研究使用Kano模型歸納重要的電子服務品質，有效樣本384份，第二個研究使用層級迴歸驗證假說，有效樣本230份。研究結果發現Facebook直播電子服務品質中，信任、可靠性、回應能力的改善，最能提高滿意度，但直播網站設計與個性化屬於無差異品質；網站設計、信任、個性化會正向影響購買意願，而黏著度則有完全中介效果。本研究為直播發展電子服務品質量表，驗證了直播購物情境下，影響購買意願的因素，對線上購物的消費者行為理論有所貢獻。然而，本研究執行之時，許多直播平台尚在萌芽，Facebook直播是最流行的，現今直播平台提供更多的服務，後續研究可多方比較不同的直播平台之服務品質，並重新驗證影響購買意願的因素。
並列摘要: Since its launch in 2016, Facebook Live Streaming has become an essential marketing channel for small businesses. Ensuring satisfaction and purchase intentions through live streaming sales is vital for business success. This study conducted two surveys targeting individuals with experience in Facebook Live Streaming. Both surveys utilized online questionnaires and convenience-sampling methods. The first study analyzed important eservice qualities using the Kano model with 384 valid samples. The second study tested hypotheses using hierarchical regression with 230 valid samples. Findings highlight that improving trust, reliability, and responsiveness can significantly enhance satisfaction in Facebook Live Streaming. Website design and personalization lie within the indifferent quality category. In terms of purchase intention, website design, trust, and personalization positively impact it, while stickiness serves as a full mediation. This study also develops an e-service quality scale for live streaming, verifies purchase intention factors in live shopping contexts, and contributes to consumer behavior theory in online shopping. However, given the emerging nature of live streaming platforms, future research should compare the service quality of different live streaming platforms and re-examine the impact of factors on purchase intentions.

主要篇名: 顧客社群參與、品牌愛慕、品牌忠誠度與品牌價值共同創造關係之探討－以星巴克粉絲專頁為例
並列篇名: Relationships among Customer Social Participation, Brand Love, Brand Loyalty, Brand Value Co-creation: A Case of Starbucks Fan Pages
作者: 張永霖=Yong-Ling Chang|鄭米淇=Mi-Qi Zheng|蔡進發=Chin-Fa Tsai
主要摘要: 品牌價值共同創造是企業與顧客的新興互動模式，其強調產品或服務的價值不再是由企業單獨提供，而是由企業與顧客共同創造。本研究以星巴克粉絲專頁成員為研究對象，檢驗「顧客社群參與」、「品牌愛慕」、「品牌忠誠度」以及「品牌價值共同創造」構念之間的關係。本研究以有追蹤星巴克咖啡同好會的使用者為研究對象，透過網路社群發放問卷進行調查，計回收有效樣本共332份，採用結構方程模式進行假說的檢定。結果指出：（1）顧客社群參與會正向影響品牌愛慕，（2）顧客社群參與會正向影響品牌價值共同創造，（3）顧客社群參與會正向影響品牌忠誠度，（4）品牌愛慕會正向影響品牌忠誠度，（5）品牌愛慕會正向影響品牌價值共同創造，（6）品牌忠誠度會正向影響品牌價值共同創造。
並列摘要: The brand value co-creation is an emerging interaction model between enterprises and customers. It emphasizes that the value of products or services is no longer provided by enterprises alone, but is co-created together by enterprises and their customers. This study takes the members of Facebook Fan Pages of Starbucks as research objects to examine the relationships among customer social participation, brand love, brand loyalty, and brand value co-creation. 332 valid questionnaires are collected through Facebook Fan Pages of Starbucks. And this study adopts a structural equation modeling (SEM) approach to examine the proposed model and the associated hypotheses. Results show that: (1) Customer social participation positively influences brand love. (2) Customer social participation positively influences brand value co-creation. (3) Customer social participation positively influences brand loyalty. (4) Brand love positively influences brand loyalty. (5) Brand love positively influences brand value co-creation. (6) Brand loyalty positively influences brand value co-creation.
關鍵字: 顧客社群參與|品牌愛慕|品牌忠誠|品牌價值共同創造|customer social participation|brand love|brand loyalty|brand value co-creation
刊名: 行銷評論=Marketing Review

主要篇名: 代言人效果與資訊細節度對低產品涉入消費者廣告態度之影響
並列篇名: The Effect of Endorser and Information Amount on Lower Involvement Customer's Ad Attitude
作者: 張淑楨=Shu-Chen Chang|王薏雯=Yi Wen Wang
主要摘要: 在行銷領域中，高涉入一直是喚起行為動機的重要因素，然而，透過廣告技巧提升低涉入者的處理動機並刺激潛在需求，是行銷領域中較少被提及的領域。本研究目的鎖定低產品涉入之消費者，探討高／低處理能力在面對（有／無）代言人與（複雜／簡單）不同廣告訊息量時的廣告態度之差異。研究透過網路問卷發放，並採用筆電與美妝二個產品。所有受測者皆完成四組研究設計（有／無代言人*複雜／簡單廣告資訊）之問卷內容。研究回收筆電89位低涉入樣本；美妝140低涉入樣本。結果顯示，低涉入且低處理能力之消費者中，廣告資訊越多，會讓低處理能力消費者的焦慮感愈重，產生較低的廣告態度；反之，低涉入且高處理能力之消費者，在有代言人的廣告中，廣告中擁有充足的周邊路徑的暗示（代言人）下，高處理能力之消費者亦會將資訊細節透過捷思處理模式主動提取大腦認知資源，並適量提升廣告態度，因此，資訊的細節度越高，擁有的廣告態度亦較高。本研究嘗試提出能有效刺激低涉入消費者對廣告產生正向態度之研究發現，並對未來產生價值性判斷或執行購買決策時的參考依據。
並列摘要: In marketing studies, higher product involvement is the important trigger to arouse behavior purchase intention because they might have higher information process motivations. However, a good advertisement would strengthen lower product involvement customer's information process motivations, then find out potential consumers. Accordingly, this study tried to discuss the advertising attitude of lower product involvement customers. This study provided four groups (with endorser/ non- endorser and simple/complex product information) to discuss the high/low information process ability customers' advertising attitude. The survey was conducted on the Internet and recruited 89 samples of the NB product/ 140 samples of the makeup product. The results showed that the lower product involvement and lower information process ability sample, the more information advertising provided, the less advertising attitude would happen. On the contrary, the lower product involvement with a higher information process ability sample would have a higher advertising attitude on endorser advertising with more product information. The study results would contribute to the theories of how to strengthen lower involvement customer's ad attitude, and might be helpful for advertising design strategies making.

刊名: 行銷評論=Marketing Review

主要篇名: 社群網站的對話溝通經營策略：從不同存續期間的手機遊戲粉絲專頁之檢討
並列篇名: Dialogue communication management strategy for Social Network Websites: A review of mobile games Facebook from different survival durations
作者: 吳宇森=Yusen Wu|陳怡廷=Yiting Chen
主要摘要: 2019年新冠肺炎疫情期間，全球遊戲產業成長大幅上升，其中成長幅度最大便是手遊市場。本研究探討手遊經營者在社群媒體的溝通經營之道，從手遊白熱化的2017年開始，篩選出台灣最受歡迎的角色扮演類遊戲，共45款為研究對象。依照遊戲存續週期長短分為三組，針對2,663則貼文，利用「網路對話溝通」五大原則進行內容分析和相關檢定。結果發現：（1）維持遊戲新鮮感不需要經常更新遊戲內容。（2）讓玩家付出才能收穫的互動方式，更能讓玩家加深遊戲的參與。（3）不斷地更新遊戲內容並不是經營手遊的最佳方式，維持遊戲環境穩定，復刻熱門活動照顧新進玩家，更受玩家喜愛。（4）相較於回應粉絲留言的關係建立，活化貼文內容的創作，才是遊戲FB粉專經營的重要策略。
並列摘要: This study examines the social media practices of mobile game operators and selects the 45 most popular role-playing games in Taiwan since 2017. The results of the study revealed that (1) it is not necessary to update the game content frequently to maintain the freshness of the game. (2) Allowing players to leave comments to receive rewards is a more effective way to deepen players' participation in the game. (3) Maintaining the stability of the game system and reproducing popular game activities to take care of new players, which is more popular among players. (4) Instead of responding to fans' messages, creating new content related to the game is the most important strategy for FB fans.

主要篇名: 行動廣告態度之研究－三成分態度模式之應用
並列篇名: The Study of Attitudes Toward Mobile Advertising: Application of the Tri-component Attitude Model
作者: 張永霖=Yong-Ling Chang|簡嘉琳=Chia-Lin Chien|孔德偉=Te-Wei Kung|蔡進發=Chin-Fa Tsai
主要摘要: 本研究以Davis等人的科技接受模式、態度三成分理論以及Bem的自我知覺理論作為理論基礎，採用認知、情感與行為三構面，來衡量消費者對行動廣告的使用態度與再使用意圖。本文採取便利抽樣方式，利用網路問卷進行調查，回收372份有效樣本，再以迴歸分析檢驗相關假設，獲致以下結果：（1）在認知變數中，行動廣告之知覺有用性、個人創新性與相容性正向影響行動廣告態度。（2）在情感變數中，行動廣告之廣告惱怒、廣告懷疑與知覺侵擾負向影響行動廣告態度。（3）在行為變數中，廣告實際使用行為正向影響行動廣告態度。（4）行動廣告態度正向影響消費者對行動廣告的再使用意圖。
並列摘要: This study aims to examine the impacts of consumer's attitude components on their usage attitude and reusing intention of mobile advertising on the basis of the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) proposed by Davis et al., Attitude components, and Self-Perception Theory proposed by Bem. This study adopts convenient sampling method to distribute the questionnaires through online using Google Form. A total of 372 valid questionnaires are collected. The questionnaire data are analyzed by regression analysis method to verify the relevant hypotheses. The results indicate: (1) in the cognition components, consumers' perceived usefulness, personal innovativeness, and compatibility positively affect consumers' attitude toward mobile advertising; (2) in the affective components, consumers' ad irritation, ad skepticism, and perceived intrusiveness negatively affect consumers' attitude toward mobile advertising; (3) in the behavior components, consumers' actual advertising usage behavior positively affects their attitude toward mobile advertising; (4) consumers' attitude toward mobile advertising positively affects their reusing intention towards mobile advertising.

主要篇名: 服務場域、體驗價值與整體滿意度之關係研究－以婚紗攝影產業為例
並列篇名: Study on the Relationships Among Servicescape, Experiential Value, and Overall Satisfaction - Based on the Wedding Photography Industry
主要摘要: 本研究旨在建構並驗證「服務場域、體驗價值與整體滿意度關係模式」，研究對象針對有實際參與婚紗攝影公司體驗的消費者，採立意及滾雪球抽樣法，以郵寄問卷和網路問卷等方式來發放進行問卷調查。經文獻回顧相關理論後，以結構方程模式與重要度績效分析法進行分析，研究結果顯示：結構方程模式分析結果，服務場域直接正向影響體驗價值，體驗價值直接正向影響整體滿意度，服務場域與體驗價值也顯著的影響整體滿意度；重要度績效分析結果顯示，服務場域品質項目，其中「等候空間的設計給人舒適的感覺」與「有完善的顧客意見反應管道」兩項屬性，為「關鍵品質屬性」，建議業者針對這些重要的屬性進行改善，將有助於提升整體經營成效。本研究整體獲得的結果，可供婚紗攝影產業擬定行銷策略之重要參考，進而達成企業永續經營的目標。
並列摘要: This study aims to construct and validate the "relationship model among servicescape, experiential value, and overall satisfaction," through a questionnaire survey with consumers of wedding photography companies as the research subjects. After a literature review of relevant theories, the structural equation modeling and importance-performance analysis were used to analyze the research results. The findings indicate that both servicescape and experiential value had a significant positive influence on overall satisfaction, and that servicescape also had a significant positive influence on experiential value. In addition, two attributes, "comfortable waiting space design," and "well-developed customer feedback channels," were identified as key quality attributes of servicescape. The overall results of this study can be used as an important reference for the wedding photography industry in formulating marketing strategies to achieve the goal of sustainable business operations.

主要篇名: 社群潛水者之認同及參與行為影響社群聲譽之研究：信任與承諾觀點
並列篇名: The Impact of Community Lurkers' Identification and Engagement on Community Reputation: Perspectives of Trust and Commitment
作者: 江志卿=Jerry Chih-Ching Chiang|邱凰資=Huang-Tzu Chiou
主要摘要: 過去關於虛擬社群的相關文獻多著重於探討具有高內在動機並積極參與社群的使用者行為，而較少關注於大多數沉默使用者對虛擬社群的影響。這種現象也觸發了本研究動機，即探索社群潛水者是否能如主動參與的使用者一樣，為虛擬社群帶來潛在效益。本研究旨在探討虛擬社群中的潛水者，其社群認同及社群參與是否影響其對社群的信任與承諾，進而影響社群忠誠及社群聲譽，促使其主動做出有利於社群社團或粉絲專頁的行為。本研究針對使用虛擬社群的潛水者進行網路問卷調查，共獲得150份有效問卷。問卷經由結構方程模式分析、結果顯示潛水者的社群認同及社群參與顯著影響其對社群的信任與承諾，進而影響其對社群的忠誠度及口碑推薦行為，亦即社群信任與承諾的提昇會增強使用者的忠誠行為及推薦意願。相關研究建議與貢獻亦於文內詳述與探討。
並列摘要: Previous research on virtual communities has predominantly focused on the behaviors of users with high intrinsic motivation who actively participate in the community, while largely neglecting the impact of the majority of silent lurkers. This oversight has prompted the motivation for this study, which aims to explore whether lurkers can provide potential benefits to virtual communities similar to those brought by active participants. This study investigates whether the identification and engagement of lurkers in virtual communities influence their trust and commitment to the community, subsequently affecting their loyalty and word-of-mouth, encouraging them to engage in behaviors that benefit community groups or fan pages. An online survey was conducted lurkers of virtual communities, yielding 150 valid responses. The survey data was analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling. The results indicate that users' community identification and engagement significantly affect their trust and commitment to the community, which in turn influence their loyalty and word-of-mouth behaviors. In other words, increased community trust and commitment enhance users' loyal behaviors and their willingness to recommend the community. Relevant research suggestions and contributions are also detailed and discussed in the paper.

主要篇名: 行動應用服務之消費者信任模式建構：期望與知覺適配之整合觀點
並列篇名: A Model Construction of Consumers' Trust in Mobile Application Services: An Integrated View towards Fits of Expectation and Perception
作者: 江志卿=Jerry Chih-Ching Chiang|楊黃琬=Marukle Huang-Wang Yang|莊詠俊=Jason Zhuang
主要摘要: 隨著新冠病毒（COVID-19）疫情加劇行動網路與行動應用服務市場競爭的白熱化，企業如何能在這塊大餅裡獲得最多客戶青睞，儼然已成為備受關注的焦點。行動應用服務不同於以往的信任構成，且業者與消費者的互動係藉由業者制定的機制進行；因此，行動應用服務業者如何藉由既定機制獲得更多消費者信任，是其能否擁有穩定客群與成功行銷的重要關鍵。依據過往諸多學者的相關研究，本研究以期望與實際使用後的差異做為建構行動應用服務之使用者信任基礎，經排除未完整填答與重複填答樣本後，針對195份有效問卷，進行資料分析與理論效度建構，最終提出一個包括品質、價值、互動、效能、以及效益等五構面的使用者信任之形成性模式（一階反映性，二階形成性，三階形成性）量表。研究建議與應用亦將於文內詳述與探討，希望能提供學術界與產業界在研擬相關行動應用服務時參考。
並列摘要: As the COVID-19 epidemic intensifies the competition of mobile application services market, how to get more attention from consumers has become the business focus. Trust in mobile application services has different characteristics of the traditional one, which the interaction between providers and consumers are followed by the providers' mechanisms. Therefore, how the provider attains consumers' trust as much as it can do, is the key to maintain a stable customer base and strategic advantages. Based on relevant research findings, this study tries to develop an integrated consumers' trust in mobile application services from the fit perspectives between consumers' expectation and their perception. As a result, 195 validated responses were used in the following data analyses and nomological validity. Finally, an integrated formative trust model consists of five dimensions including quality, value, interaction, effectiveness, and benefit of mobile application services is proposed. Suggestions and managerial implications are also discussed.

主要篇名: 手機遊戲美學、口碑與使用意願關聯之研究
並列篇名: The Relationships Among Aesthetics of Mobile Game, Word of Mouth and Usage Intention
作者: 劉仲矩=Chung-Chu Liu|黎乃瑜=Nai-Yu Li|王家祥=Chia-Hsiang Wang
主要摘要: 智慧手機已是多數人不可或缺的電子產品，在幾乎人手一機的加持下，造就一波行動裝置商機，其中遊戲類應用程式是下載率的常勝軍。過去研究多以應用程式的設計及技術層面進行探究，然技術上的突破或創新終究有所極限，將美學概念引入，似乎是一條新的道路。美不僅存在於藝品，近年來更發展為美學經濟，美學經濟在行銷概念上是融入美的感官互動、情緒、氛圍、思考等體驗，及生活中對美感的一切經驗，來促進具有深度與感動的消費行為，商品設計者在傳統上除了實用，更遠大的意義應就在於美感價值的創造。美學經濟是繼知識經濟之後，可爲企業創造更高附加價值的一種新行銷理念。所以本研究欲探討手機遊戲美學對使用意願之影響，然遊戲的口碑亦是重要左右因素，即便開發費用所費不貲還不如擁有好口碑更具影響力。本研究將手機遊戲美學區分3類，如視覺性、體驗性及聽覺沉浸性，干擾變數－口碑則區分為2類，如內、外生口碑，共蒐集513份實體問卷，運用階層迴歸方式分析，期望對將來手機遊戲之設計概念提供指引，以吸引玩家拓展市場。
並列摘要: Smart phones are one of the "Must Have" electronic products for most of people. Almost everyone owns a smart phone and this phenomenon facilitates another wave of commercial opportunities of mobile devices. Within these opportunities, mobile games applications often provide highest download rate. In the past, many mobile application based studies which focused on application designs and technical level were conducted. However, technical breakthroughs or innovations have their constrains, by introducing the concept of aesthetic seems would be a new path to reach more constrains. Aesthetics does not merely exist in arts and it has been developed as aesthetic economy. In the employment of the concept of marketing for aesthetic economy, it has integrated experiences of interactions of aesthetic sense, emotions, atmospheres and thoughts for enhancing the depth and touched consuming experiences via aesthetic of living. Based on traditional thoughts, for merchandise designers, the more farseeing meaning means a creative aesthetic value than a practical design. Further to the knowledge economy, the aesthetic economy would be a new marketing concept that creates more added value for the enterprise. Hence, this study's intent is to probe into the influence of mobile game usage intention which effects by aesthetics of mobile games. However, the word of mouth also plays a significant influential factor rather than high developing expenses on mobile games. There are 513 samplings has been collected for this study, sampling are analyzed via software and mobile game aesthetics are categorized as visual, experiential and auditory-immersive aesthetics; the word of mouths are categorized as intrapersonal environment and extrapersonal environment word of mouth which are analyzed via hierarchical regression. This study expects to offer a definite direction of design for the concept of the research and development of mobile games in the future in order to attract more mobile game users for expending the mobile game market.

主要篇名: 共享經濟廣告該強調平台還是供應商好呢？廣告焦點對於廣告效果之影響
並列篇名: Should Advertisement of Sharing Economy Emphasize on Platform or Provider? The Influence of Advertising Focus on the Advertising Effect
作者: 劉瑀溱=Yu-Zhen Liu|陳少萍=Shao-Ping Chen|余淑雲=Shu-Yun Yu|鄭兆宏=Zhao-Hong Cheng
主要摘要: 近年來共享經濟受到廣大消費者的青睞，並帶動各式新興的商業模式與營運平台的誕生。共享經濟平台的提供者包括平台和供應商，過去文獻對於廣告應聚焦於平台或供應商未深入探討，因此本研究以共享經濟平台為研究背景，企圖瞭解廣告焦點（平台vs.供應商）如何影響廣告效果，以廣告焦點與廣告效果關係會因產品類型（享樂型vs.實用型）不同和品牌熟悉度高低而產生差異，交互作用效果會透過知覺價值影響廣告效果。透過實驗設計法驗證研究假說，分別以圖片廣告及文字廣告進行不同類型操弄。實驗一檢測產品類型是否調節廣告焦點對廣告效果的影響，透過訂房平台圖片廣告分別呈現平台樣式及供應商描述進行廣告焦點操弄，以不同房型（休閒型和商務型）分別代表享樂品和實用品，結果顯示：（1）當產品為實用型產品時，廣告焦點為平台會有較佳的廣告效果；（2）當產品為享樂型產品時，聚焦於平台或供應商無顯著差異；（3）產品類型與廣告焦點的交互作用效果會透過知覺價值影響廣告效果。實驗二檢測品牌熟悉程度是否調節廣告焦點對廣告效果的影響，透過廣告文字進行廣告焦點操弄，並以知名品牌（Uber）與虛構品牌（Call Car）進行品牌熟悉度操弄，結果顯示（1）當品牌熟悉度高時，廣告焦點為平台能獲得較好的廣告效果；（2）品牌熟悉度低時，廣告聚焦於供應商的廣告效果較佳；（3）品牌熟悉度與廣告焦點的交互作用效果會透過知覺價值影響廣告效果。
並列摘要: Recently, the sharing economy has been favored by consumers and has led to the birth of various emerging business models and operating platforms. The providers of sharing economy platforms include the platform and the provider. The past literatures about whether the advertising focus should be on platforms or providers were lack of deep exploration. Therefore, this study used the sharing economy platform as the research background and attempted to understand how the advertising focus (platform vs. provider) affects the advertising effect. This study proposed that the relationship between advertising focus and advertising effect would be vary due to the different product types (hedonic vs. practical) and the level of brand familiarity. The interaction effect would affect the advertising effect through perceived value. This study validated the research hypothesis through the experimental design method. Experiment 1 detected whether the product type adjusted the impact of the advertising focus on the advertising effect, the advertising focus was manipulated through presenting platform and provider descriptions on the booking platform image advertisements, and the different room types (leisure type and business type) were used to represent hedonic products and utilitarian products. The results are as follow. (1) When the product is a utilitarian product, a better advertising effect would be achieved if the advertising focus was the platform. (2) When the product is a hedonic product, there is no significant difference between focusing on the platform or the provider. (3) the interaction effect of the product type and the advertising focus would affect the advertising effect through perceptual value. Experiment 2 tested whether brand familiarity moderated the influence of advertising focus on advertising effect, and used the advertising text to manipulate the advertising focus. The manipulation of brand familiarity was highly famous brands (Uber) or fictional brands (Call Car). The results are as follow. (1) When brand familiarity is high, the advertising focus on platform could have a better advertising effect. (2) When the brand familiarity is low, the advertising focus on providers could have better advertising effect. (3) The interaction between brand familiarity and advertising focus would influence the advertising effect through perceived value.

主要篇名: 企業內部管理與市場競爭策略之同等性分析
並列篇名: The Equivalence between Internally Vertical Control and Competition Strategies
主要摘要: 企業為了獲取最大的利潤，往往會訂定各種市場競爭策略，但企業在制定市場競爭策略時，常會受到該國的「反拖拉斯」等相關法律之約束，因此某些可以增進獲利的市場競爭策略無法採行，而企業的內部管理卻不受該項法律之限制。本文試圖建立一個經濟學模型，說明企業可藉由市場競爭策略以取得競爭優勢，若市場競爭策略因法律之限制而無法採行，只要企業採取適當的內部管理模式，也可達到與市場競爭策略相同的效果。亦即，企業的市場競爭策略與其內部管理具有相同的效果。文中我們也分析，國際間的反拖拉斯政策之差異對國際貿易結果的影響，並對我國政府執行公平交易法提出建言。
並列摘要: To maximize its profit, a firm can use market competition strategies or internal administration. However, some of its beneficial market competition strategies contradict the Anti-trust law, so it is impossible to enforce these strategies. In this paper, by a game theory model, we explore the equivalence between a firm's internally vertical control and its competition strategies. First, we examine how a firm can use the vertical restraints to obtain the market competition leadership. Then, we show that a firm's internally vertical control has the same effects as these competition strategies. Furthermore, we also examine how Antitrust Law affects the international trade outcomes, and give some suggestions for the Fair Trade Commission how to enforce the Fair Trade Law to regulate firms' vertical restraints.

主要篇名: Generic Advertising in Market Demand
並列篇名: 一般性廣告封市場需求的影響
主要摘要: 本文從理論與實證分析的角度探討一般性廣告對需求曲線的影響，進而當市場清結時，均衡價格與數量即可得知。有別於之前文獻只討論線性需求函數，本文著重廣告對非線性需求函數的影響，主張廣告會造成非線性需求曲線的曲度擴大。實證分析以美國牛肉市場為例，期間從1976至1996年。結果發現一般性廣告對美國牛肉市場需求曲線的影響符合本文假設，即需求曲線的曲度增加。此外，本文並建議若配合市場供給可計算市場均衡價量，如此可更完整與正確地評估廣告的效率性。
並列摘要: This paper reconsiders the impacts of generic advertising on commodity prices induced through demand effects. Rather than considering a simple demand shift, we consider the possibility that advertising leads to a change in curvature of the demand curve. To evaluate this possibility we consider U.S. aggregate demand for beef. Quarterly data from 1976 through 1996 is used. Based on parametric tests, we find evidence consistent with convexity in the demand curve for beef with respect to its own price. Further, we find evidence that the demand elasticity and the convexity of demand are affected by the intensity of generic advertising.

主要篇名: Exploring the Consumer Behavior That Influences Student College Choice
並列篇名: 消費者行爲影響學生選校之探究
主要摘要: 本文探討消費者行為影響學生選校的因素，且著重於探討學生選校過程的抉擇階段，即為Hossler和Gallagher三階段選校過程的最後階段。  為了瞭解學生如何選擇所要就讀的學校，本研究對395位經由推薦甄選管道入學，就讀台灣北部某私立大學的大一學生作問卷調查。受訪學生針對影響選校消費價值的題項給予評分，收回問卷的相關數據，經由描述分析，測定各消費價值影響學生選校決定異數分析、獨立樣本t檢定，檢驗學生學業成績和性別的兩個變項，對選校考量是否有顯著差異。研究結果發現，消費價值並未影響學生選校決定；然而學生們認為，以功能價值評估上述該所大學具有的特色時，則結果顯示某些程度地影響他們的選校決定。再者，考驗結果發現，學業成績變項對友善而開放的校風特色有顯著差異，即學業成績高的學生比學業成績低的學生注重友善而開放的校風；性別對學校臨近許多都市活動的特色有顯著差異，即男學生比女學生注重學校臨近許多都市活動的特色。  此研究結果呈現有關該大學本身優劣之處，相關大專院校可引為參考，而該大學應運用行銷策略，以滿足學生們的需求。
並列摘要: This study examined consumer behavior influencing student college choice. The study focused on the choice stage, which is the last of Hossler and Gallagher's three-stage college-choice process.  To understand how students select their institution, a survey was administered to the 395 freshmen who received recommended admission from a private university in northern Taiwan. The survey asked respondents to assign numerical ratings to statements regarding consumption values influencing their college choice; Descriptive analyses were conducted to determine the extent to which students used each of consumption values. Inferential analyses, including one-way ANOVAs, and independent sample I tests were then used to determine the differences to which students perceived each of the characteristics of the selected university.  The findings revealed that students considered the consumption values to have a neutral effect on their college choices. However, students' opinions on the impact of the functional value upon the selected university's characteristics varied between neutral and agreement. Furthermore, significant differences regarding characteristics based on students' demographic characteristics were found. Students with higher GPA scores perceived the selected university has a friendly, open atmosphere to be significantly more important than did students with lower scores, and males perceived the university is located near many city activities to be significantly more important than did females. These findings provide practical information in identifying the strengths and weaknesses of the selected university. Institutions, especially the selected university, can utilize the results to apply institutional marketing to accommodate the demands of its current and potential students.

主要篇名: 服務品質、關係品質、關係價值與顧忠誠度的關係之整合分析—以行動電信産業之消費者爲例
並列篇名: An Integrated Analysis of Relationship between Service Quality, Relationship Quality, Relationship Value and Customers' Loyalty-An Example of Consumers of Mobile Telecommunication Industry
作者: 林隆儀=Lin, Long-Yi|簡任群=Chien, Jen-Chun
主要摘要: 隨著行動電信市場趨近飽和，成長率將不若以往，這種情況使得行動電信服務業者不但要繼續提升服務品質，也必須改變其行銷策略，將重心放在既有顧客的維繫。本研究嘗試在關係行銷的領域中，探討行動電信業者在服務傳遞過程中所提供給顧客的服務品質、關係價值和關係品質，及其對顧客忠誠度的影響。本研究以行動電信使用者為調查對象，採用便利抽樣法訪問台北縣市地區300位使用者，回收有效樣本268份，並以線性結構關係模式為分析方法進行實證研究，主要研究發現有(1)服務品質對關係品質有正向且顯著的影響，(2)服務品質對關係價值有正向且顯著的影響，(3)關係價值對關係品質有正向且顯著的影響，(4)關係品質對顧客忠誠度有正向且顯著的影響；關係價值亦對顧客忠誠度有正向且顯著的影響；服務品質對顧客忠誠度有顯著的影響，但卻為負向，不過服務品質對顧客忠誠度的直接負向效果較小，其透過關係價值與關係品質對顧客忠誠度所產生的間接正向效果較大，就總效果來看，服務品質對顧客忠誠度具有正向的總效果。
並列摘要: Nowadays as the mobile telecommunication market is being saturated, the growth rate won't be higher than some time ago. The situation makes mobile telecommunication companies not only promote their service quality, but also change their marketing core strategy on holding their exist customers. The main purpose of this study is to explore the service quality, relationship value and relationship quality that mobile telecommunication companies provide for customers and their effect on customer loyalty. The region of our study focused on Taipei City and County, with experimented objects for mobile telecommunication users. There were 300 questionnaires distributed, and 286 effective samples were received. We applied LISREL analysis methods to verify model. Basically, we simply conclude the following four aspects: (1) Service quality has significantly positive effect on relationship quality. (2) Service quality has significantly positive effect on relationship value. (3) Relationship value has significantly positive effect on relationship quality. (4) Relationship quality has significantly positive effect on customer loyalty; relationship value has significantly positive effect on customers' loyalty; Service quality has significantly effect on customer loyalty, but it's negative, while the direct negative effect that service quality has on customer loyalty is minor, on the other hand the indirect positive effect that service quality has on customer loyalty through relationship value and relationship quality is major. In sum, the total effect that service quality has on customer loyalty is positive.

In repeated proposal, however, the agenda setters with two contrary interests parties will propose the collusion solution to the median voter.

主要篇名: 經濟發展與國防需求關係之研究
並列篇名: Economic Development and Demand for National Defense Security
作者: 汪進揚=Uang, Jinn-Yang|趙一鳴=Jaw, I-Ming
主要摘要: 國家經濟力與國防需求的關係，一直是學界與實務界關切的課題；鑑於此，本研究以全球166個國家，1991至2000年資料，從長期平均的觀點探討其間的關係。研究結果顯示，國防需求代理變數「國民負擔軍費」與「國民所得」呈顯著的正向關係，亦即經濟力愈強的國家會有愈高的國防需求。為了驗證上述結果的穩定性，本研究將調查期間區分為兩個時段進行相同的測試，研究結果指出二變項在時間上呈現穩定的關係。研究中另以「每人力軍費配額」、「國防預算」與「高科技軍人比例」作為國防需求的代理變項，進行敏感度測試，實證結果仍支持上述的關係。
並列摘要: The relationship of state economic strength with national defense demand has been of a major concern to practitioners and academicians. To address this issue, a long-term average point of view is taken in this study. Using a sample of 166 countries and ten-year investigation period spanning from 1991 to 2000, our results demonstrate that 'Income Per Capita' is positively associated with 'Defense Expenditure Per Civilian,' indicating that countries with stronger economic strength have more demand for national defense security. We reexamine this issue by dividing the ten-year investigation period into two five-year periods; the results show that the relationship of the two variables remains stable across the two time windows. In addition, we further examine the relationship by using alternative proxy variables for extent of national defense demand as follows: total defense budget, defense budget per militant, ratio of militants in high-tech military services. All the sensitivity tests lend support to the above findings.

主要篇名: 現金流量對研發、廣告關係影響
並列篇名: The Impact of Cash Flow on the Relationship between R&D and Advertising
主要摘要: 本文利用台灣製造業資料，以Morishima (1967)之替代彈性定義式，衡量研發與廣告關係；並以縱橫資料(Panel data)分析法，建立「廣告對研發」關係、「研發對廣告」關係迴歸實證模型，進行及比較OLS、LSDV及GLS估計。研究結果發現，製造業全產業「廣告對研發」關係為互補，「研發對廣告」則呈現替代關係；主要實證結果指出，在其他情況不變下，現金流量波動愈大，資金取得成本提高，廠商以研發取代廣告之意願增強；然而，面對既定研發活動，為確保研發投入及其成果，廠商同時搭配廣告之意願提高。此一結果呼應文獻「研發與廣告決策受現金流量波動影響」之論點外，進一步指出研發與廣告關係亦受現金流量波動程度之影響。
並列摘要: The paper performs a firm-level panel data model to estimate the impact of cash flow on the relationship between R&D and advertising. The relationship between R&D and advertising measured by Morishima (1967) approach for Taiwan's manufacturing data shows that the relationship of advertising to R&D is complementary, but the relationship of R&D to advertising is substitute. The impact of cash flow volatility on the relationship between R&D and advertising is studied. For isolating the effect of cash flow volatility, the various non-cash flow factors that affect the R&D and advertising incentive is taken into account. The empirical results show that higher cash flow volatility is associated with higher complementary degree of advertising to R&D and higher substitute degree of R&D to advertising.

並列篇名: A Study on Bank Credit Risk Management Framework
作者: 楊素柳=Yang, Suh-Lew|黃愷婷=Huang, Kai-Ting
主要摘要: 面臨即將實施之新巴塞爾資本協定(Basel Ⅱ)，以及符合風險導向之金融監理趨勢，銀行應建置健全完整之信用風險管理架構，以提升本身風險控管的能力，因應風險管理時代的來臨。健全的銀行信用風險管理架構於建置時應包括制度面和執行面，制度面包括組織結構的設計、信用風險管理策略以及風險管理程序的訂定；而執行面則包括風險的確認、衡量、決策、執行、評核與檢討。Basel Ⅱ提供銀行審視本身風險管理技術之契機，銀行應由改變人員對風險的觀念開始著手，建置包含制度面和執行面之健全信用風險管理架構並確實予以執行，以落實風險控管，達到穩健經營，提升經營績效的目標。
並列摘要: With the coming implementation of Basel Ⅱ and the increasing focus on risk-based financial auditing, each bank should develop a comprehensive credit risk management framework and improve its capability in order to face the new era of risk management.  A comprehensive risk management framework for a bank should include both systematic and execution components. The systematic component includes the design of organizational structure and the development of credit risk management strategies and processes. The execution component includes the risk identification, measurement, decision-making, execution, auditing and evaluation.  Basel Ⅱ provides the banks with the opportunity to evaluate their risk management capabilities. The banks should begin by changing their employees' attitudes toward risk and then develop comprehensive risk management framework that includes systematic and execution components in order to achieve consistent risk management with improved results.

主要篇名: 金融風暴對股市間波動性的連動性影響—ARJI模型
並列篇名: Impacts of Asian Financial Crisis on the Co-movements across Stock Markets Volatility in ARJI Model
作者: 邱建良=Chiu, Chien-Liang|李彥賢=Lee, Yen-Hsien|鄒易凭=Tzou, Yi-Pin
主要摘要: 本研究以ARJI跳躍擴散模型探討金融風暴對美國、日本、韓國、香港、新加坡與台灣股市產生跳躍頻率與跳躍所引起的變異，並比較總變異、跳躍所引起的變異與擴散所引起的變異在金融風暴期間與非金融風暴期間比較是否有差異，最後利用一般化衝擊反應函數來分析美國、日本、韓國、香港、新加坡與台灣股市波動性間的關係。實證結果發現：1.各國股價指數報酬率均存在著跳躍行為與跳躍頻率是隨著時間變動，跳躍過程所引發的變異是不可忽視的重要因素。2.金融風暴事件對台灣股市波動性並沒有很重大的影響；此外，金融風暴期間的美國股市的波動性小於非金融風暴期間。3.本研究利用波動性的Pearson相關係檢定發現各國波動性間的關係皆呈現顯著，在金融風暴後的波動性相關係數幾乎皆比在金融風暴前的相關程度更高。4.在金融風暴後，美國股市波動性較具獨立性的特性，其干擾項的影響對其他國家最為顯著，其次為台灣，因而提供投資人在進行跨國投資組合的決策時，美國或台灣市場是一個值得考慮投資市場。
並列摘要: This paper employs ARJI model to examine jump frequency and volatility of the co-movements across stock markets and compares whether jump and diffusion induced volatilities are different during Asian Financial Crisis period. Financial utilize GIRF to analyze the relationship among U. S., Japan, Korea, Hong Kong, Singapore and Taiwan. The empirical results indicate that, firstly, jump intensity and frequency are time variant. Second. Asian Financial Crisis does not bring great impact to Taiwan. Volatility of US stock market during non-Asian Financial Crisis period is smaller than that during crisis period. Thirdly, the results of Pearson test indicate that the relationships of volatility among these countries are significant, and the coefficient correlation of volatility after Asian Financial Crisis is mostly higher than that before crisis. Fourthly, after Asian Financial Crisis, the volatility of US stock market relatively has independent character and impact to other countries, secondly is Taiwan. Therefore, while making the investment decision in oversea market, it is worthy to consider the stock market of U.S. or Taiwan.

主要篇名: 應用模糊化Stulz模型於彩虹選擇權之評價
並列篇名: Pricing Rainbow Options Based on the Fuzzy Pattern of Stulz Formula
作者: 李沃牆=Lee, Wo-Chiang|黃淑菁=Huang, Shu-Ching
主要摘要: 本文挑選金融類、傳產類、電子類及混合類等四種組合來設計兩資產彩虹選擇權。根據過去學者研究之結果，以準蒙地卡羅法（Sobol低差異序列）模擬標的資產價格，再以MGARCH模型估計波動率，又採用移動相關係數，代入Stulz評價模型，如此便可得到彩虹選擇權的理論價格。接著，藉由模糊化標的資產價格、波動率、相關係數以及距到期期間，創新建立模糊化Stulz評價模型。並檢定出該模型與傳統Stulz模型之評價結果有顯著差異，表示模糊化Stulz評價模型可用於彩虹選擇權之評價。
並列摘要: In this article, we design four kinds of two-asset rainbow option, namely finance, conventional industries, electronic, mixed finance with electronic rainbow option respectively. In our empirical study, we use Quasi Monte Carlo Method for the simulation of underlying asset price. Additionally, we utilize MGARCH model for estimating volatility and put the moving correlation coefficient into pricing model. Then, we may obtain rainbow option's theory price. Furthermore, we consider the fuzzy stock price, fuzzy volatility, fuzzy correlation coefficient and fuzzy maturity as input variables. Then, the fuzzy pattern of Stulz formula is proposed in this paper Empirical result shows that the Fuzzy-Stulz Model can be applied in rainbow option pricing.
